settings.heading: DETAILS ABOUT ARTCLUB
settings.content:
1. LETTER FROM THE FOUNDER:

Dear art lovers,

I am Sebastian Krauß, the founder of Artclub. We are all about the simple but powerful idea that everyone should experience the joy of real art. Artclub is my centrepiece, a place where we make hand-picked works of art accessible - works that not only delight the eyes, but also touch the soul. I invite you to explore this beauty and find what resonates with you.

Your Sebastian Krauß

2. OUR VALUES:

Authenticity first and foremost

At Artclub, we take great care to ensure that every piece of art you find with us is genuine and authentic. We work directly with talented artists from around the world to bring you original artworks and limited editions that will transform and inspire your space.

Unique artworks for your home

Whether you're buying your first artwork or looking to add to your existing collection, Artclub offers a unique selection that will enhance any home. Discover art that tells stories and evokes emotions.

Buy art safely and easily

With Artclub, buying art online is safe and straightforward. Enjoy our hassle-free ordering process, secure payment methods and our commitment to customer satisfaction with a transparent returns policy.

settings.heading: FREE SERVICE
settings.content: Send a photo of your wall to sk@artclub.wtf and my team will photoshop it onto your wall so you can see how it will look and what size and frame will fit best. Send your photo today and you will receive the result back by email within 1-2 working days. This service is free of charge.
